args.title: Fix parsing in src/ingest/parser.ts to skip trailing empty lines
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Update parseStatement to better detect and skip trailing empty lines that contain no columns rather than only popping a single empty string line. This prevents the 'Malformed row' error thrown by assertShape on empty trailing rows.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/ingest/parser.ts is involved because it manages CSV parsing and the issue lies in how trailing empty lines are handled in the parseStatement function. Improving this detection and skipping of empty lines fixes the 'Malformed row' error caused by assertShape.
